fixture: Bootstrapped observed menu nutrition/prices and stored real embeddings; synthetic cities, service areas, freshness and availability
limitations: No live provider latency or spend
No HTTP/TLS/network or login load included
Not millions of distinct real menus; no human relevance labels
Unused global HNSW index omitted; this measures exact local retrieval, not ingestion throughput

environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 16.15 (Debian 16.15-1.pgdg12+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit

http_load.transport: ASGI in-process; excludes TCP/TLS and external providers
